LanguageData.USAC_CorpseStorage.label: USAC standard corpse storage solution
LanguageData.USAC_CorpseStorage.description: The only corpse storage container USAC currently certifies as humane, holding several bodies in a compact footprint. It can be ordered solely through USAC-authorized dealers. A clear step up from body bags: powered refrigeration means stored assets lose no value at all over time, which makes this the best option for long-term preservation.
